snippet.title: Arknights: Endfield [Sketches of Lost Heirlooms] Version Trailer
snippet.description:
In storytelling scrolls, it's often said: Deep in Sword Vault Dale, woods whisper in the wind. Rockhowlers play above the shadowed stream, its cry a rumbling hymn. 
The peaks are fair, yet each step hides a snare. Where does the treasure rest? The tale shall tell when next we meet, dear guest.
